title: Memory: what the bot remembers
hook: A model forgets everything between calls. Memory is what your software puts back on its desk.
inPlainWords: A model remembers nothing between calls. "Memory" is whatever your software puts back in front of it each time, and the rules about what to keep and what to forget.

useCase.title: A returning customer says "Same problem as last week"
useCase.story: The bot should know last week's ticket, the customer's language preference, and the current conversation.

approaches.name: No memory
approaches.what: Every message starts from a blank page.
approaches.example: The bot asks for the order number again and again.

approaches.name: Recent chat in the prompt
approaches.what: Send the last messages with every request.
approaches.avoidWhen: Long ones. Cost grows and the desk overflows.

approaches.name: Summaries
approaches.what: Compress older conversation into a short summary.
approaches.example: "Customer had a broken blender and is waiting for a replacement."

approaches.name: Long-term memory store
approaches.what: Save facts like preferences and past cases, and look them up later.
approaches.avoidWhen: Sensitive data without consent and controls.
approaches.example: Saved: prefers email; ticket 771 about a blender.

approaches.name: Search over past tickets
approaches.what: Use RAG over old conversations and tickets.

challenge.question: The customer says "same problem as last week". What gives the best answer?

options.why: It has to ask the customer to explain everything again.

options.text: Search past tickets and read a short saved profile
options.why: It finds the right case and only brings in what is relevant.

options.text: Send the customer's entire three-year history every time
options.why: Costly and noisy, and it exposes far more than needed.

options.text: Only the last 10 messages of this chat
options.why: Helps within a session, but last week is out of reach.

bestCase.title: Short-term chat plus searchable long-term facts, with controls
bestCase.example: The bot retrieves ticket 771 (blender, replacement pending) and says "I see your blender replacement from last week. It shipped yesterday." The customer can view and delete what is saved about them.

worstCase.title: Forgetting everything, or remembering too much
worstCase.example: Either the bot asks the same five questions every visit and the customer leaves, or it stores card details and health remarks in memory and repeats them to the wrong person.

steps.label: Look up memory
steps.goes: It finds ticket 771 and the profile: email, English.
steps.goesWrong: No lookup. The bot says "Which problem? Please describe it again."

steps.label: Build the prompt
steps.goes: Question, recent chat, and only the relevant memory.

steps.label: Language model
steps.goes: It writes a reply that uses that context.

steps.label: Update memory
steps.goes: New facts are saved. The customer can review or delete them.

takeaway: Memory is retrieval plus rules: what to keep, what to forget, and who may see it.
